decisions.reason: Real incident writeup with a named exploited CVE: Anubis ransomware hit Fairlife (Coca-Cola-owned) via CitrixBleed 2 (CVE-2025-5777), encrypted Nutanix systems, stole ~1TB, suspended U.S. production for ~11 days. New fact beyond July coverage: the CVE-2025-5777 initial-access vector.

CVE-2025-5777.evidence: According to published reporting, Anubis exploited CitrixBleed 2 (CVE-2025-5777) to gain initial access to Fairlife's environment before encrypting its Nutanix infrastructure.

decisions.reason: CyberScoop expert-reaction piece on the same presidential memo story (already 5 events): legal/practical pitfalls of enlisting private firms in federal law enforcement hacking, 60-day implementation window. Fixes mechanical clustering.

Substantive law-enforcement outcome: insider contractor Cameron Nicholas Curry sentenced to 2 years for extorting Siemens-owned Brightly Software (~$2.5M demanded, $7,540.92 paid, six counts of extortion).
